comments.author: JWalter89
comments.body:
"Super organized code" - source, trust me bro

Come on dude, you can't make a claim like that and give absolutely 0 proof. That's what lets people double down on everything being AI slop

replies.author: Demintika
replies.body:
AI code gives the illusion of organized and structured. But then you try to add one feature and realize it's a complete mess, because the whole thing need refactor to accommodate that new feature.

You have to hold its hand every step of the way for a hope of truly organized code.

replies.author: JWalter89
replies.body: Yep, absolutely right. If your process doesn't involve consistent code reviews and frequent engineering tidy-ups you are inevitably going to hit a wall.

replies.author: Leather_Swing_3092
replies.body: You make a great point, over all I'm happy with what's been produced, Cheers.
